---- MODULE FlashWithMutex ----
EXTENDS FlashWithMutexDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL PF == INSTANCE TLAPS

AGDataTypes ==
    /\ \A p \in NODE :
         /\ (Proc[p].CacheState \in {"CACHE_S", "CACHE_E"} => Proc[p].CacheData \in DATA)
         /\ (UniMsg[p].Cmd \in {"UNI_Put", "UNI_PutX"} => UniMsg[p].Data \in DATA)
    /\ (WbMsg.Cmd = "WB_Wb" => WbMsg.Data \in DATA)
    /\ (ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_ShWb" =>
            ShWbMsg.Data \in DATA /\ ShWbMsg.Proc \in NODE)

AGTypeInv == TypeOK /\ AGDataTypes

LEMMA AGTypeInitial == Init => AGTypeInv
BY PF!SMTT("r10") DEF Init, AGTypeInv, AGDataTypes, TypeOK, CACHE_STATE, NODE_CMD, UNI_CMD, INV_CMD, RP_CMD, WB_CMD, SHWB_CMD, NAKC_CMD, DataU, NodeU, UniU

LEMMA AGTypeStep == AGTypeInv /\ [Next]_vars => AGTypeInv'

      PROVE AGTypeInv'
<2>1. ASSUME NEW src \in NODE, NEW data \in DATA, Store(src, data)
      PROVE AGTypeInv'

<2>2. ASSUME NEW src \in NODE, NEW c \in ReqCmd, PI_Remote(src, c)
      PROVE AGTypeInv'
